metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over South Los Angeles, California lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data for tropospheric NO2 concentration - Location: South Los Angeles, California (approximately 33.9°N, 118.2°W) - Compare three time periods: Oct 1-23 for years 2018, 2019, and 2021 - TROPOMI NO2 band: "NO2_column_ppb" or similar 2. **Masking strategy**: - TROPOMI data should be filtered by quality assurance value (QA > 0.5 or similar) - No cloud masking needed for this satellite product; instead use QA flags - Check for valid pixel counts 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Compare mean NO2 values across the three years - If 2021 value < mean(2018, 2019), answer is A (Yes) - If 2021 value >= mean(2018, 2019), answer is B (No) - If any collection is empty, return C1 - If valid pixels are 0 after QA filtering, return C2 - If result is None/NaN, return C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define South Los Angeles region const losAngelesAOI = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.2, 33.9]).buffer(50000); // Time periods: October 1-23 const startDay = '-10-01'; const endDay = '-10-24'; const date2018Start = '2018' + startDay; const date2018End = '2018' + endDay; const date2019Start = '2019' + startDay; const date2019End = '2019' + endDay; const date2021Start = '2021' + startDay; const date2021End = '2021' + endDay; // Function to get TROPOMI NO2 data and calculate mean async function getMeanNO2(startDate, endDate, year) { const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_L3_NO2') .filterBounds(losAngelesAOI) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('NO2_column_ppb'); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { console.log(`${year}: No images found`); return null; } // Filter by QA value (>0.5) const filtered = collection.map(img => img.updateMask(img.select('QA_VALUE').gte(0.5))); // Calculate pixel count const countImg = filtered.select('NO2_column_ppb').first(); if (countImg === null || countImg === undefined) { console.log(`${year}: First image null`); return null; } const countDict = countImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: losAngelesAOI, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount = countDict['NO2_column_ppb'] || 0; if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log(`${year}: No valid pixels after QA filtering`); return null; } // Calculate mean NO2 const meanDict = countImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: losAngelesAOI, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const meanNO2 = meanDict['NO2_column_ppb']; if (meanNO2 === null || meanNO2 === undefined || isNaN(meanNO2)) { console.log(`${year}: Invalid mean value`); return null; } console.log(`${year}: Imgs=${size}, ValidPx=${pixelCount}, Mean=${meanNO2.toFixed(3)} ppb`); return meanNO2; } // Get data for all three years const mean2018 = await getMeanNO2(date2018Start, date2018End, '2018'); const mean2019 = await getMeanNO2(date2019Start, date2019End, '2019'); const mean2021 = await getMeanNO2(date2021Start, date2021End, '2021'); // Validate data if (mean2018 === null || mean2019 === null || mean2021 === null) { console.log('Missing data for comparison'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Compare 2021 to average of 2018 and 2019 const meanHistorical = (mean2018 + mean2019) / 2; console.log(`Avg(2018,2019): ${meanHistorical.toFixed(3)} ppb`); console.log(`2021 / Avg: ${(mean2021 / meanHistorical).toFixed(3)}`); if (mean2021 < meanHistorical) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
